profile.headline: Software Developer at Blue Cross Blue Shield

company.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Illinois, Montana, New Mexico, Oklahoma & Texas

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Developed RESTful API's with a focus on test-driven development 
•Optimized database queries and implemented parallel querying, reducing execution time by 30%
•Collaborated with cross-functional teams to identify inefficiencies resulting in improved application stability and a more efficient code base
•Designed and implemented efficient Makefiles, streamlining project set up for new developers
•Mentored new developers on tool stack usage, team processes, and expectations

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
•Developed new features and maintained a healthcare management application using Java Spring Boot for backend development and Javascript for frontend development
•Refactored legacy code by updating aging dependencies and rewriting segments of code with extensive documentation
•Created unit tests using JUnit and utilized debuggers for code analysis
•Worked in an Agile environment and used Scrum best practices to meet goals each sprint

positions.title: Demand Planner
positions.description:
• Managed sales forecasting and ordering decisions, resulting in a 95%+ in stock rate while decreasing yearly warehouse holding costs by 25%
• Automated routine tasks using Excel VBA, reducing manual workload by 30% 
• Collaborated with sales, production, customer, and management teams to create long-term sales forecasts and purchasing plans

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•Analyzed customer feedback and other datasets to identify trends to improve operational efficiency and increase customer satisfaction.
•Collaborated with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements, resulting in increases in order fulfillment speed and customer satisfaction.
•Utilized route planning software and tools to improve the accuracy and efficiency of delivery routes, reducing total delivery times

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description: • Using a customer-centric sales approach to deliver exceptional customer service and meet targets for sales and customer satisfaction.
